title: RT.DY.------POL.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 373 (PMBA-37). RT-DY (reality dynamics) is the subject; POL-DY (political dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars), T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and INFO-DY. From SOC-RT-P: INFO-TRNS (information transference). From INFO-TRNS: JR-DYM (journalism dynamics) and INFO-ALGN (information alignment). From JR-DYM: INFO-FM (information forum). From T-C-IMP: EXP-DT (expansion dictates). From INFO-DY: IST-F (isolated focus). From IST-F: TM (terminology—or terms of a definition).
